title: Validate browser evidence bytes
responsibility: Accept only supported, intact evidence media and explain refused content.

inputs.name: browserArtifact.media
inputs.description: The evidence bytes and their exact media type, passed together to the hosted artifact reader. The media type must appear in artifactMediaTypes.

inputs.name: browserArtifact.sha256
inputs.description: The expected SHA-256 digest supplied with the captured bytes to the hosted artifact reader. The adapter passes it through and rethrows failures whose message contains SHA-256.

outputs.name: browserArtifact
outputs.description: The value resolved by hostedArtifact after it accepts the supplied media and digest. This adapter does not declare the returned value's concrete shape.

errors.name: Browser artifact media or integrity failure
errors.description: Throws Error for an unsupported media type or a hosted-artifact failure. SHA-256 failures are rethrown unchanged, errors containing 11 MiB are replaced with the page's size message, and other hosted-artifact failures use the unsupported-content message.
